description:
How a whole category's prices moved between two dates, in one call: the
    biggest regular-price rises and falls, promotions starting and ending,
    member price changes (Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards, Lidl Plus)
    and pack-size changes, kept apart, with a
    summary over every product compared (average and median shelf change,
    counts of rises and falls) overall and per store.

    shelf_rise and shelf_fall are changes to the regular price;
    promotion_started and promotion_ended are changes in what was paid while
    the regular price stayed the same (a product at 18 euro on promotion and 23
    euro after is a promotion ending, not a 27.8% price rise); loyalty_change
    is a member price moving; pack_change is the same product in a different
    pack size, confirmed over three days of records (a smaller pack at the same
    price is a hidden rise). on_promotion_both_dates marks a shelf change in
    the label's "was" price while the offer price paid did not move.

    Each mover returned costs one credit; the summaries are free.

    Args:
        from_date: the earlier date, YYYY-MM-DD (prices recorded since May 2026).
        to_date: the later date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.
        group: a kind of product: beer, cider, wine, spirits, alcohol, or any
            product type such as breakfast cereal, butter, coffee, crisps,
            nappies. Narrower words work too ("vodka", "red wine").
        query: product or brand words, with or without group
            (e.g. "guinness").
        category: an aisle name to narrow by.
        store: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl; leave out for all five.
        kinds: which lists to return (default all six).
        rank_by: "pct" (default) or "eur".
        limit: most products per list (default 10, max 50).
name: price_movements

kind.description: shelf_rise, shelf_fall, promotion_started, promotion_ended, loyalty_change or pack_change
kind.title: Kind

on_promotion_both_dates.title: On Promotion Both Dates

clubcard_price.title: Clubcard Price
